candidates.title: Senior Product Operations Lead
candidates.description: Lead Product Operations and improve how Product, Engineering and Customer teams work together. Build scalable workflows, use customer feedback to improve priorities and lead cross-functional process improvement. Drive workflow automation, change management and product adoption. Senior leadership experience and professional English required. German is not required.

candidates.title: Senior Implementation Lead
candidates.description: Own customer onboarding and implementation programmes for B2B enterprise customers. Coordinate Engineering and Customer Operations, drive adoption and improve delivery processes. Lead cross-functional process improvement. Extensive hands-on experience configuring and deploying enterprise integrations is required. Professional English required.

candidates.title: Junior Account Executive
candidates.description: Sell subscription products to new customers and meet monthly revenue quotas. Build outbound sales pipelines, negotiate contracts and manage prospecting. This is a junior commercial role for a candidate beginning their sales career. Native-level German is required. Experience in account management and cold calling is helpful.
